title: SSH is running on the default port (22)
desc: Port 22 is the first target of automated scanners and brute-force attacks on the internet. Moving to a different port removes almost all of that traffic.
desc_mixed: Port 22 is still open (also listening on: {{diger}}). If the migration is complete, close 22 — the attack surface remains while it is open.
